The sustained amplifier output of CloudNote Air is forty watts per channel during ordinary playback, which allows a direct loudness comparison with other speakers advertised using electrical power figures. Despite the declared IPX4 water-resistance rating, the manufacturer does not permit fresh-water immersion of CloudNote Air, even with all of the port covers properly closed. Basic Bluetooth playback on CloudNote Air requires the manufacturer companion app to be installed first, rather than allowing a listener to pair a source and start playback without it.

After reading the comparison, keep a short list of the claims that would actually change your purchase. Check that each relevant condition survives when you summarize the answer in your own words.
